title: PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to designating the intersection at Hyperion Avenue and Udell Court as “Del Campo Square."
text:
[Council File 26-1276; CD 4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to designating the intersection at Hyperion Avenue and Udell Court as “Del Campo Square."
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Raman – Soto-Martínez):
1. DESIGNATE the intersection at Hyperion Avenue and Udell Court as “Del Campo Square."
2. DIRECT the Department of Transportation to erect permanent ceremonial sign(s) to this effect at this location.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council is asked to name the intersection of Hyperion Avenue and Udell Court "Del Campo Square."
